mapper.sql: id, target_type, target_id, target_name, alias, address, user_id, remind_time, remind_msg, status, trigger_time, is_open, is_read, repeat_type, repeat_interval, next_remind_time, repeat_end_time, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reminder ( id, target_type, target_id, target_name, alias, address, user_id, remind_time, remind_msg, status, trigger_time, is_open, is_read, repeat_type, repeat_interval, next_remind_time, repeat_end_time, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( IFNULL(#{id}, UUID()), #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{targetName}, #{alias}, #{address}, #{userId}, #{remindTime}, #{remindMsg}, #{status}, #{triggerTime}, #{isOpen}, #{isRead}, #{repeatType}, #{repeatInterval}, #{nextRemindTime}, #{repeatEndTime}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime} )
mapper.select: SELECT FROM reminder WHERE status = 'pending' AND is_open = 1 AND remind_time <= #{beforeTime} ORDER BY remind_time ASC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reminder WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'triggered' AND is_read = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE reminder SET is_read = 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
